descriptionChirho: A person who bears testimony or gives evidence, whether in a judicial, historical, or theological context. The singular and plural forms reflect the same core meaning across all attestations. Multilingual evidence uniformly confirms a single sense: spa 'testigo/testigos,' hin 'gavaah/gavaahon,' arb 'shahid/shuhud,' kor 'jeungin,' swa 'shahidi/mashahidi.' The NT uses this term for eyewitnesses of events (Acts), legal witnesses (Matt 18:16, 2 Cor 13:1), and witnesses to the faith (Heb 12:1, Rev 1:5). No semantic split between singular and plural; these are purely morphological variants of one lexeme.
